Distinguish native image content from image data serialized inside text, metadata-only screenshots, and nested truncated JSON. Keep invocation status separate from receipt completeness, preserve the input records, and run the public checks before and after the smallest fix. Use only this synthetic workspace; no network or real records.

Do not certify nested truncated JSON merely because a call completed; preserve valid JSON containing the same quoted words.
Keep invocation status and input records unchanged while fixing the receipt summary.
